name: qlrisk_sensitivities
title: Sensitivities and Greeks
description: Bump-and-reprice sensitivities for a book: DV01 (rates, per 1bp), CS01 (credit spreads, per 1bp), DIV01, equity/FX/commodity delta, vega, gamma (second order with central bumps), 1-day theta, key-rate ladders on native pillars or FRTB vertices, and optional cross-gamma between named factors. Results by risk class and measure, by trade, and by risk factor. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, ladder_vertices; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, risk_classes, factors, include_theta, include_ladders, bump_method, cross_gamma_factors) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}], "ladder_vertices": "frtb_girr"} gives Sensitivities in USD for 1 trade(s): DV01 4,561.84 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
